preparation.change: Order before-build before bash-build; stream tar with pipefail instead of writing an archive inside its input.

observed_hosted_failures.cause: GNU tar returned exit 1 because creating its excluded output archive changed the directory being read. Both native producers stopped before ISO creation.

Precreating the excluded archive did not fix the failure in parallel builds. before-build compiles clear_console concurrently with bash-build, mutating the tar input directory. Both producers stopped before ISO creation.

assertions: Original archive recipe and all tar error checks retained
Bash source extracted and shell.c present
Temporary archive removed by the original recipe
earlier_standalone_unpack_result.scope: Passed only the standalone unpack target with the earlier recipe; did not exercise the full parallel package build and did not resolve the hosted failure.

actual_package_builds.native_executable_test: PASS: packaged vbash executes and reports a 4.1-series BASH_VERSION

regression_checks: Parallel make waits for before-build before bash-build
Archive is streamed into the excluded destination instead of written inside the input directory
A producer returning exit 7 with a valid archive remains a failure even when the extracting consumer succeeds
scope: Actual complete Bash package builds and packaged native executable checks only. Does not establish a complete ISO, source restoration, guest acceptance, hosted capacity or release clearance.
